output_list.reason: The transferOwnership function allows anyone to change the owner of the contract. This can lead to unauthorized access and loss of funds if the owner is maliciously compromised.
The approve function allows anyone to approve spending of their tokens by another address. This can lead to unauthorized spending if the spender is maliciously compromised.

The approveAndCall function allows anyone to approve spending of their tokens by another address and call a function on the spender. This can lead to unauthorized spending if the spender is maliciously compromised.
The transferFrom function allows anyone to transfer tokens from another address on behalf of the owner. This can lead to unauthorized spending if the owner is maliciously compromised.
The setPrices function allows anyone to set the sell and buy prices of the tokens. This can lead to unauthorized price manipulation if the owner is maliciously compromised.
